candidates: S3 bucket named by OUTPUT_BUCKET (does not exist in eu-north-1 or is misnamed)
OUTPUT_BUCKET environment variable definition in the IaC template for UploaderFunction
answer.explanation: Every UploaderFunction invocation in the window fails with NoSuchBucket on S3.PutObject (handler.py line 29, Bucket=OUTPUT_BUCKET). The error is a missing bucket, not AccessDenied, so it is not an IAM permission problem. The other functions (CrudApi, Thumbnailer, Compression) run without errors in the same window. The bucket name in OUTPUT_BUCKET therefore most likely points to a bucket that does not exist, which points to the live environment variable configuration. The IaC template may have the same wrong value, so it is listed as a secondary candidate. No CODE change is indicated because the failing call is the same across all invocations and the traceback shows correct API usage.
